newRules: Charter-school positions, and vague "educational choices" with no mention of public money for private schools, are not scored on the education axis. Kept only when the source explicitly covers vouchers, ESAs, or school choice beyond charters.
A campaign-site or social photo that is the same image as a txcourts.gov portrait counts as the court portrait, not a campaign photo; use another own headshot (own social profile).
Radio/TV station credits (e.g. "WBLS") are media photos even when openly licensed on Commons.
